newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly lower in the Wednesday after-hours session, as heavy long-liquidation in the spot October contract pushed down the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.8 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Newly listed benchmark March ended at 136.2 yen, down 0.1 yen from the day's close. Volume was 10,022 lots.
After the market started the day on a weaker tone, falls in producing countries added to price losses, they said.
"The market is approaching the bottom. In my view, any further falls should be limited," one trader said.
